response_payload.rationale_summary: Normalized federal funds rates for 1980-10-19 to 1980-10-22: 12.310, 12.370, 12.610, 13.110. Computed successive changes: +0.060 (10/19→10/20), +0.240 (10/20→10/21), +0.500 (10/21→10/22). Mean of the two preceding changes is (0.060+0.240)/2=0.150. The 10/21→10/22 change differs from this mean by 0.500-0.150=0.350.
